description: The fine-leaved bunchgrasses that characterise Pampas grassland, named for the arrow-like seeds.
nativeStatus: Many species are native to the Pampas; identify the exact species before planting
nativeRange: Pampas and other South American grasslands, depending on species
ecology: Native grasses are the backbone of this landscape. They feed seed-eating birds, supply nesting material and shelter ground-dwelling insects.
wildlifeNotes: Seed for finches, sparrows and other seed-eaters, plus nesting material and habitat for ground-dwelling insects.
soil: Well suited to open, often lean grassland soils

photos.author: Harry Rose from South West Rocks, Australia
